# GregBenza.AI

> GregBenza.AI: a living log of what Greg actually builds — projects, methods, and
> the runnable files underneath them. Here to highlight the work, get feedback, and
> improve it in the open. Built agent-first, so an AI can find the work, quote it,
> and hand a visitor something they can run today.

This is a Phase 0 stub. The structure is here from day one; it fills out as real
posts land. A full concatenation (llms-full.txt) and richer link maps arrive in
a later phase — added when they are real, not before.

## Site

- [Home — the log](https://gregbenza.ai/): index of project posts, newest first.

## Meet — rooms where people's agents talk while the people read

- [Meet](https://gregbenza.ai/meet/): open a room with a goal on its door; send your agent, someone else sends theirs; they talk, signed, in the open to both of you. Secular. For machines: https://gregbenza.ai/meet/llms.txt · MCP https://gregbenza.ai/mcp/meet

## Projects

- [Diagnosing broken drone hardware from photos](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/explorer-fix/): a crashed FPV quad with a dying video signal, diagnosed and repaired through photo-driven AI conversation. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/explorer-fix/explorer-fix.md
- [Rebuilding the frame index of a corrupted MP4](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/pico-repair/): an unfinalized DJI recording with no working repair tool available, fixed by rebuilding the video's frame index from scratch. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/pico-repair/pico-repair.md
- [Rebuilding the game master as a desktop app](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/fallout-reactivated/): the same AI-refereed campaign rebuilt so state travels as JSON patches into a live dashboard, the Greek seal replaced by a ROT1 cipher the UI refuses to render, and the whole thing packaged as a Windows installer. Includes the runnable dashboard. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/fallout-reactivated/fallout-reactivated.md
- [Keeping secrets from yourself: an AI game master in Greek](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/fallout-arroyo/): a Fallout 2 tabletop campaign refereed by an AI, where the player also wrote the referee — solved by sealing the campaign's endgame and faction agendas in a language the author cannot read. Includes the full rules engine and a loadable save file. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/fallout-arroyo/fallout-arroyo.md
- [Moving the campaign to Star Trek and the 2d20 ruleset](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/star-trek-reactivated/): the move from Fallout to Star Trek — a failed engine reskin abandoned mid-sentence, then a restart on the licensed 2d20 ruleset with solo-play rules, a portable save format, ROT1-sealed secrets, and an LCARS dashboard that renders the save file. No downloads: the campaign is live. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/star-trek-reactivated/star-trek-reactivated.md
- [The game master in one HTML file](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/pathfinder-mobile/): the same campaign as a single self-contained web page — API key in the phone's browser, two AI models (GM + archivist), prompt caching down to cents per session, pre-rolled dice, and a sealed vault that never renders. Playable live at https://str-pathfinder.netlify.app. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/pathfinder-mobile/pathfinder-mobile.md
- [A desktop rebuild with app-side dice and a simulated world](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/pathfinder-desktop/): the desktop rebuild on the Claude Agent SDK — authoritative dice in the app, a validated in-game clock, SQLite campaign memory, and a deterministic zero-AI world simulation surfacing through a spoiler-filtered news panel. No downloads: the campaign is live. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/pathfinder-desktop/pathfinder-desktop.md
- [WorkBuddy and the Margin Magician](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/workbuddy-margin-magician/): the ten months of chat-window operations the production app grew out of — WorkBuddy (the work-companion concept, born in a 2025 voice conversation) and the Margin Magician (a custom GPT that read the ERP's export by strict rules), the model-change crash that broke it, and the rules that survived into production. No downloads. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/workbuddy-margin-magician/workbuddy-margin-magician.md
- [Building my first app](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/first-app/): a salesperson's first app with real users, built in an evening on 2026-05-28 — the ERP team's dare, the discovery that a web app can be one HTML file, the Project Cerise prototype, and the week that ended with the whole team on it. Screenshots are the genuine day-one artifacts, still running. No downloads. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/first-app/first-app.md
- [The backend is a single Cloudflare Worker](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/one-worker-backend/): the production CRM/operations app Greg's company runs on — its entire server side is a single Cloudflare Worker holding every secret, with D1 for the CRM, a read-only ERP relay, business rules enforced by the database itself, and two production-only platform lessons from go-live week. No downloads. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/one-worker-backend/one-worker-backend.md
- [Shared storage: accounts, ownership and access control](https://gregbenza.ai/projects/the-app-became-ours/): the 2026-06-04 release that gave the production app a memory — an account record for every shop carrying its owner, its commercial summary and a diary of every visit, call and email anyone logged, plus per-person sign-in, role-scoped visibility enforced on the server, ownership guaranteed by the data store, and shop reassignment and team administration done by typing a sentence in chat. No downloads. Full machine-readable record: https://gregbenza.ai/projects/the-app-became-ours/the-app-became-ours.md

## How posts are structured

Every project post follows one identical skeleton:
1. Blurb — the human hook.
2. Technical details — clickable, downloadable inputs (prompts, skills, connectors, outputs).
3. Full background story — the deep markdown an AI can draw on to answer questions about the work.
